method: Compared 84 initially open AI Mode tabs, all 300 visible history entries and a refreshed open-tab inventory. Prior source media, source gaps, original video and Captain of industry GTM remain preserved. The previously identified accidentally regenerated Banana Cavendish thread remains excluded.
